# Runtime playback fixtures

The 3.4–4.2 folders contain unmodified official Spineboy exports from [EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes](https://github.com/EsotericSoftware/spine-runtimes), `examples/spineboy/export/`. The 3.4 files use `spineboy-mesh`; the skeletons and atlas were renamed to `spineboy-pro` so the viewer resolves both formats by base name. Image page names inside the atlas are unchanged. The 3.4 `vine` subfolder contains the corresponding official `examples/vine/export/` files to exercise path constraints.

The **3.2 folder is a synthetic reference fixture**, not an export obtained from a user's project. `create-3.2-reference.cjs` encodes its binary and JSON against the official 3.2 Java format reader (source revision in `vendor/README.md`). It covers shear, weighted and linked meshes, bone/slot/IK timelines, custom curves, FFD offsets, draw order, and signed events. `square.png` is a generated solid-color test texture.

The applicable Spine licenses are included in `vendor/LICENSE.spine-3.2`, `vendor/LICENSE.spine-3.4`, `vendor/LICENSE.spine-3.6`, `vendor/LICENSE.spine-3.7`, `vendor/LICENSE.spine-3.8`, and the installed official 4.x packages. The tests open both binary and JSON skeletons, select an animation, and verify playback advances. JSON-only folders exercise normal folder selection for every runtime with the binary-file filter enabled, UTF-8 BOMs, uppercase extensions, and a differently named sole atlas. Original user assets are not modified.

Optionally set `SPINE_TEST_ASSET_FOLDER` to test an additional local asset folder through the normal folder selection flow. This is read-only and the screenshot/result are saved under `.temp/`.

The 3.0 and 3.1 folders are synthetic reference fixtures generated by create-early-reference.cjs against the archived Java readers documented in vendor/README.md. The 3.3 fixture is derived from the official 3.4 mesh fixture with only the version header changed to 3.3.07; this tests the identical final 3.3/3.4 wire layout, and is not a genuine 3.3 export. The 3.5 fixture is the official tag 3.5.51 Spineboy export (its actual export header is 3.5.03-beta). Playback and JSON folder selection are exercised for all added minor series. The initial 3.6 UI sample now uses the checked-in official fixture so tests do not depend on user backup folders.
